brokered_connections_holder_check.name: brokered_connections_holder_check
brokered_connections_holder_check.value: ("brokered_connections"."holder" = 'person' AND "brokered_connections"."user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("brokered_connections"."holder" = 'deployment' AND "brokered_connections"."user_id" IS NULL)

voice_sessions_summary_check.name: voice_sessions_summary_check
voice_sessions_summary_check.value: ("voice_sessions"."summary_status" = 'ready' AND "voice_sessions"."summary" IS NOT NULL) OR ("voice_sessions"."summary_status" = 'failed' AND "voice_sessions"."summary" IS NULL)

credit_reservations_terminal_check.name: credit_reservations_terminal_check
credit_reservations_terminal_check.value: ("credit_reservations"."status" = 'reserved' AND "credit_reservations"."terminal_at" IS NULL) OR ("credit_reservations"."status" <> 'reserved' AND "credit_reservations"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL)

credit_reservations_settled_check.name: credit_reservations_settled_check
credit_reservations_settled_check.value: "credit_reservations"."status" <> 'settled' OR ("credit_reservations"."actual_numerator" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "credit_reservations"."actual_denominator" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "credit_reservations"."actual_denominator" !~ '^0+$' AND "credit_reservations"."charged" >= 0 AND "credit_reservations"."applied" >= 0 AND "credit_reservations"."applied" <= "credit_reservations"."maximum" AND "credit_reservations"."released" = "credit_reservations"."maximum" - "credit_reservations"."applied")

usage_outbox_credit_identity_check.name: usage_outbox_credit_identity_check
usage_outbox_credit_identity_check.value:
(
        "usage_outbox"."reservation_id" IS NULL
        AND "usage_outbox"."actual_cost_numerator" IS NULL
        AND "usage_outbox"."actual_cost_denominator" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "usage_outbox"."reservation_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "usage_outbox"."actual_cost_numerator" ~ '^[0-9]+$'
        AND "usage_outbox"."actual_cost_denominator" ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
      )

access_grants_revoked_at_check.name: access_grants_revoked_at_check
access_grants_revoked_at_check.value: (("access_grants"."status" = 'active' AND "access_grants"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("access_grants"."status" = 'revoked' AND "access_grants"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL))

gateway_price_snapshots_status_details_c.name: gateway_price_snapshots_status_details_consistent
gateway_price_snapshots_status_details_c.value: ("gateway_price_snapshots"."price_status" = 'unknown') = ("gateway_price_snapshots"."price_status_reason" IS NOT NULL) AND ("gateway_price_snapshots"."price_status" = 'unknown') = ("gateway_price_snapshots"."price_status_missing_dims" IS NOT NULL)

mastra_tenant_storage_state.name: mastra_tenant_storage_state
mastra_tenant_storage_state.value: ("mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."status" = 'provisioning' and "mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."claim_token" is not null and "mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."credential_ref" is null and "mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."runtime_role" is null and "mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."ready_at" is null) or ("mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."status" = 'ready' and "mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."claim_token" is null and "mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."credential_ref" is not null and "mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."runtime_role" is not null and "mastra_tenant_storage_registry"."ready_at" is not null)
